text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki seems under the weather, so I send her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My deepest apologies. I'll be sure to get proper rest to avoid causing you further concern.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm?! What is this place?

text_block_list.name: Crow Tengu
text_block_list.text: So you awaken, young one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Gyah! You're… a tengu?!

text_block_list.name: Crow Tengu
text_block_list.text: For you to have been brought here before me… You must desire to undergo my training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I-I've heard that, in ancient times, the names of warriors who studied under the tengu spread far and wide.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It would be an honor to receive your instruction!

text_block_list.name: Crow Tengu
text_block_list.text: Hah… In that case, follow me! If you can keep up, that is!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ridiculous! Even if I'm out of sorts, I'll chase you for a thousand miles if it means attaining mastery!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Crow Tengu
text_block_list.text: A fine performance, Yaeno Muteki! Heh-heh… You certainly don't appear to be out of sorts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm?! Now that you mention it… I was so absorbed in running that I started sprinting without even realizing it!

text_block_list.name: Crow Tengu
text_block_list.text: You look to be past your troubles. Good. Now, return to the world from whence you came!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Master Tengu. Thank you for your guidance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki is brimming with energy, showing no signs of being unwell. I guess she had a pretty nice dream.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Agh! The sheer speed—I can't hope to catch up!

text_block_list.name: Crow Tengu
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… You have a long way to go, Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What is the meaning of this?! I couldn't even complete training in my own dreams!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she's rested up, Yaeno Muteki remains out of sorts.
